findings.relation: The candidates accurately describe continuous residence for five years as a requirement before title could be received, without asserting that any claimant completed it.
findings.evidenceExcerpt: Among its provisions was a five-year requirement of continuous residence before receiving the title to the land

candidates: The story is about a provision that connected a claim to land with the possibility of receiving its title: continuous residence for five years was required before title could be received. The reader should understand this as a conditional path from claim to ownership, not evidence that a particular claimant completed it.
- **Development:** Explain the stated condition: five years of continuous residence before title could be received.
- **Endpoint:** Clarify that the provision made continuous residence a requirement along the path from claim to title.
